description: ENSO climate impact scenarios for Philippine food prices
methodology: Historical correlation analysis between ENSO ONI index and WFP food price year-over-year changes. Impact lags of 0, 3, and 6 months tested; best lag selected per ENSO state. Scenarios show expected price change range (mean ± 1 std dev) during each ENSO phase.

data_sources.climate: NOAA CPC Oceanic Nino Index (ONI v5)
